title: A claude -p timeout in a pool kb or web run is one failed run, not a lost chunk
goal: bench_pool's kb and web runners catch agent_bench.execute's TimeoutExpired and record the run as an error, as the router and hook runners do, so run_tasks writes the chunk's cells and rows; today the exception is re-raised at run_tasks and the chunk writes no rows. Found by the SP-hm4qgf3t review (no chunk hit it).
